[[File:Mimi Audino.png|thumb|250px|Mimi and her Audino]] '''Mimi''' (Japanese: '''マオ''' ''Mao'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW035|Where Did You Go, Audino?]]''. [[Officer Jenny]] asked {{an|Iris}} and [[Christie]] to watch after Mimi's {{p|Audino}} after many other Audino began to disappear in the town. Mimi was concerned that her Audino would be the next to disappear. However, Christie and Iris assured her that they had everything under control and put a tracking device on her Audino. Her worst fears came true when Audino began to act strangely and left her side. After the case was solved, it is assumed that Mimi got her Audino back safe and sound. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Mimi |pkmn=Audino |width=68 |type1=Normal |epnum=BW035 |epname=Where Did You Go, Audino? |img=Mimi Audino.png |vaen=Alyson Rosenfeld |desc=Mimi's {{p|Audino}} was suspected to be the next victim of the Audino disappearance case. Iris and Christie watched after it and put a tracking device on it so that even if it ran away, they would be able to follow it. Soon Audino began acting strangely and left Mimi. It joined up with two other Audino and traveled to {{TRT}}'s secret base all while trying to throw {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} off their trail. After {{AP|Roggenrola}} used {{m|Stone Edge}} on the sound wave machine, Audino joined forces with the other Audino that Team Rocket lured and sent them running with a barrage of different moves. None of Audino's moves are definitely known but it is possible that it knows {{m|Psychic}}, {{m|Charge Beam}}, {{m|Hyper Beam}}, {{m|Shadow Ball}}, {{m|Ice Beam}}, or {{m|Solar Beam}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color light}}|bordercolor={{normal color}} |ja=藤村知可 ''[[Chika Fujimura]]'' |en=[[Alyson Leigh Rosenfeld]] |cs=Jitka Moučková |fi=Taru Tikkanen |no=Siri Nilsen |pl=Julia Kołakowska |pt_br=Jussara Marques |es_eu=Crismar López}}
